# Meatloaf

A meatloaf baked in a loaf pan, with a ketchup glaze made in a non-stick pan once the meatloaf is out of the oven.

- Serves: 4 (the right-hand column of the table serves 8)
- Total time: 80 minutes
- Oven: preheat to 180°C (350°F)

## Ingredients

| Ingredient | Serves 4 | Serves 8 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ground beef and pork | 500 g | 1000 g |
| Onion | 1 | 2 |
| Breadcrumbs | 40 g | 80 g |
| Milk | 60 ml | 120 ml |
| Egg | 1 | 2 |
| Salt | 1 teaspoon | 2 teaspoons |
| Ketchup | 4 tablespoons | 8 tablespoons |
| Worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons | 4 tablespoons |
| Soy sauce | 1 tablespoon | 2 tablespoons |
| Cornstarch | 2 teaspoons | 4 teaspoons |
| Water | 100 ml | 200 ml |

## Method

1. Chop the onion finely and soak the breadcrumbs in the milk (10 minutes).
2. Put the meat, onion, breadcrumbs, egg and salt in a bowl and knead until sticky (5 minutes).
3. Press the mixture into the loaf pan and smooth the top (5 minutes).
4. Bake in the oven preheated to 180°C (40 minutes).
5. Leave the meatloaf in the pan to rest (10 minutes).
6. Put the ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, 1 tablespoon of soy sauce and the water in the non-stick pan and bring to a boil (5 minutes).
7. Stir in the cornstarch mixed with a little water until the glaze thickens, then slice the meatloaf and pour the glaze over it (5 minutes).

If the glaze is too thin, add cornstarch one teaspoon at a time. Wash the non-stick pan with a soft sponge only.
